turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and when?
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
That's your job, not mine. Who decided, and when?
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
I'm not writing your script. You gave my son a zero; show me why.
